description: This file defines the OTPRequest class used for handling One-Time Password (OTP) request data within the security infrastructure of the Fineract project. It includes fields for the token and associated metadata, along with methods for creation and validation.

classes.name: OTPRequest
classes.description: Represents an OTP request with token and metadata, providing methods to create and validate OTP requests.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an OTPRequest instance with specified parameters such as token, token lifetime, extended access token flag, and delivery method.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the OTP request is still valid based on the current time and the token's expiration time.
